title: Jude and the Cover
author: Kestrel Nystrom
blurb: Wren Iversen, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must trade the one secret worth killing for before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
